scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.release: if [ "$(basename $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel))" = "scaffold-ts-project" ]; then echo '🚨 ERROR: You are still inside the scaffold repository! Run "bun run scaffold" first.'; exit 1; fi && bun run test && bun run build && if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain dist)" ]; then git add dist/ && git commit -m "build: automated production asset release"; fi && git push
scripts.scaffold: rm -rf .git && git init && git add . && git commit -m 'initial commit: scaffolded from template'
